title: Reflective member access in application code (java)
description: The code reaches a member through obj.getMethod. Reflection selects the method or field by name at runtime, so a name that comes from a request runs a member the developer never intended to expose.
remediation: Keep reflective lookups on constant names, and gate any dynamic lookup behind an allowlist, for example an interface call on a typed object.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the reflective call without tracing the name.
